title: Malkav and the brothers
summary: Clan legends of the Malkavian Antediluvian.

claims.text: Malkavian tales say Saulot and Set came to console Malkav. Set held that truth is found in the depths of the soul; Malkav, that it comes from eyes that see too much. Asked to judge, Saulot could not answer and set out to find one.
Before leaving, Saulot gave a sword to Set and a crown to Malkav, took a staff of thornwood from Set, and let Malkav draw an eye on Saulot's brow in blood.
The clan holds that Malkav was later broken apart, that every Malkavian descends from that broken state, and that Malkav chose a sacred number of childer, said to be eight, 12, 20 or 36.
An old song makes Zillah Malkav's sire and beloved, whom Malkav later helped destroy.

title: The Madness Network
summary: The shared mind that links the Malkavians.

claims.text: Every Malkavian is thought to be tied to a disembodied web also called the Cobweb or the Tapestry. Most hear only a faint flutter a few times a year.
Outsiders can learn Dementation but never hear the Network. Any Caitiff shown to reach it is usually hunted down.
A Malkavian childe abandoned at the Embrace is usually as mad as the rest, but never develops the clan Disciplines; a rare few come through sane and are always cast out as Caitiff.

Dementation was sealed off from the Camarilla Malkavians for centuries, and they imitated its Network powers with Auspex and Obfuscate. It has since reawakened across the clan; a few were untouched and keep Dominate.

title: Malkavian Time
summary: The Trait that tunes a Malkavian to the Network.

claims.text: Malkavian Time is a clan-only Talent. About a week before a major clan gathering, Wits + Malkavian Time is rolled in secret.

One success gives an urge to go to the place as it begins; three give a night or two of warning and its purpose; five give a week's warning and a clear vision. Six or more risk picking up an elder's derangement.
Those with more than three dots can often hear a clanmate's death scream within the city.
To send a deliberate message, roll Wits + Malkavian Time at difficulty 9: it reaches one person within the city and carries up to two words per success.

title: Vasantasena
summary: The Malkavian antitribu seer of the Sabbat.

claims.text: Born a princess of an Indian royal house near the end of the first millennium, Vasantasena was Embraced by a wandering Malkavian holy man, and the two came to Europe in the time of the Inquisition.
They helped rally the clan behind the new Camarilla, but Vasantasena turned from it over its disbelief in the Antediluvians and led a brood of anarchs into the young Sabbat.
Vasantasena's knowledge of the Camarilla's founding and tactics may have saved the Sabbat. The seer scorns the Paths of Enlightenment and greatly fears the Antediluvians.
It is said that Vasantasena's Auspex sees everything that happens in the Sabbat.
